notes.title: Update 0.4.2 and Free Weekend!
notes.notes:
We have a big and small update at the same time!
Small in download size but big in content!

- All world now have a unique special boss that has a very low chance of spawning at any normal enemy spawner everywhere in every world except for the slayer dungeons! Take on these difficult bosses and prepare for a tough fight!
- Titant III has been spotted and can now be challenged through the Slayer Hunter! Prepare yourselves as he is one of the toughest bosses in the game currently!
- A new upgrade tier for all Bug equipment can now be crafted with the crafter in Minatia!
- Celestial Glaciadon II has been spotted and can now be challenged through the Slayer Hunter! He is the most powerful boss in the game as of this update! So be prepared!

That is all! Thank you all for reading, and next update will be Update 0.5.0! Get ready for sneak peaks and updates on that in the coming weeks!

notes.title: Patch 0.4.1
notes.notes:
Just a small update, mostly for early game stuff!

- Slight nerf to the Reaper Bowtie
- Slightly buffed the Peasant Slime's drop rates!
- Added an item to World 0 that should greatly help with fighting big groups of enemies!
- Added more interactables in Trottaville
- Added Reaper Slime encounters into Slime Castle

notes.title: Major Update!!! Version 0.4.0!
notes.notes:
It's FINALLY here!
After almost an entire year of little updates due to college, stress, and a million other things, update 0.4.0 is FINALLY here! And there is a LOT to enjoy here!!!

ADDITIONS:
- Glacial Forest is here, a new town, new dungeons, and new npc's!
- Dozens of new enemies to fight and conquer!
- A handful of new Achievements to earn!
- New equipment to buy to help you fight against the enemy horde!
- A new teammate has been spotted! Find and rescue them!
- With this new teammate, there is now Party Formation! Rearrange your team in a way that better fits your playstyle, or helps match against the upcoming fights!!!
- A new crafter is in World 3 and is ready with a brand new set of gear to help you! As long as you're willing to put in the work!
- There has been a Major update to ALL Slayer Bosses! New and old! All Slayer Bosses now have a unique "Element" that they will use against you! This new element makes these fights even more difficult than they were before! However, never fear, as a new merchant has arrived and camps out outside of each Slayer Dungeon, ready to help! For a price of course!
- ??? Now has a visual face that matches the art style of the rest of the game! Consistency is beautiful, unlike him.
- There is a brand new Slayer Dungeon Teleporter that can take you to any Slayer Dungeon at anytime! Once you unlock each worlds teleporter at least!
- All enemy overworld triggers respawn faster, making grinding and Slayer Boss grinding easier!

FIXES/CHANGES: 
- Fixed more grammer and spelling errors.
- Fixed some dialogue with Gerrin showing up in world 1 before you get him.
- Made it so Sophie and Lucy's standard magic attacks also generate Item Charges, making it easier to use held items on them!
- Rearranged the skills on all weapons so they're consistent!
- The sign outside of Hazy Mines is now readable!
- Changed the title screen music! I like this one more!
- Slightly changed some of the wall textures in nearly all indoor maps.
- Changed the battle music for all Secret Bosses and Overworld Mini Bosses. Overworld Mini bosses and Story Mini bosses will have different battle themes.
- Gave Sliebomination II and Titant II a new drop!
- Gave Queen Ant a rare drop since she's a refightable miniboss.
- Fixed a BUNCH of issues with the crafters!
- Increased the amount of XP Titant and Nightshot give.
- Added the descriptions for the Apple Munch, Orange Munch, and Tomato Munch abilities!
- Gave Titant a unique "Slayer Ability" to help him stand out more from Sliebomination.
- Renamed the existging achievements to make them more unique!
- Fixed one of the doors in Spiritdrop Hotel taking away the wrong key!
- Slightly changed the intro cutscene!

I want to thank you all for being so patient with me for this update as I know it took WAY too long! And, you have my promise, you will NOT have to wait this long for 0.5.0! Have a great day everyone and stay awesome!!!

notes.title: Patch 0.3.3
notes.notes:
Patch 0.3.3 comes with a handful of fixes and additions!

* Added a Secret Boss to World 2! Have fun!
* Put some enemies into World 2 that I missed.
* Added a custom made Title Screen!!!
* Added the NPC's to Glacilia! Including the shop, blacksmith, and inn! However the Chief's house and the Item Crafter will be unavailable until update 0.4.0.
* Fixed the snow effect not playing after leaving the houses in Glacilia.
* Gave Nightshot II a new attack!
* The Boss Seller now sells the item that allows you to refight the World 2 Chapter Boss!
* Buffed the upgraded version of the crafting weapons! Aka the Goopy, Fang, and Haunted weapons!
* Gave the Ghostly and Haunted Ring increased defense against Undead type enemies to match with the other rings giving a similar effect!
* Added a brand new plugin that gives all characters a more detailed stat sheet!
* Fixed some grammar and spelling errors.
* Added a Save Crystal to the inn in Trottaville.
* Buffed the Goo Absorb Spell.

And, most importantly
* I HOPEFULLY fixed the Steam Achievements!

And that's it for todays patch!!!
See y'all for some 0.4.0 sneak peaks in the coming weeks!!!

notes.title: 0.3.2 Patch
notes.notes:
Happy new year everyone and I am so sorry for the lack of updates!
College last semester was insane for me and my free time was greatly neutered. However, we are back this year with a decent sized patch!

- Added the rarities to the capes and caps that were missing it.
- Fixed some of the capes being attached to the head instead of the body as they were suppose to be.
- Fixed Titant II's stats.
- Added in an option to cancel any Slayer Quest! (This took forever haha).
- Nightshot II has been spotted! Good luck, he is EASILY the hardest boss in the game right now!
- Explore a little bit of the upcoming World 3! All the way into the new town which has very little to it, but is still a cozy place regardless!

I want to thank you all for your patience with me. World 3 is currently in development and I cannot wait to show it off to all of you once it's finished! Stay tuned and game on!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Just a small update for the game as there was something I forgot to put in the game.

- Added the 2 Pink Keys in the Spiritdrop Hotel. Now the treasure rooms can be accessed.
- Fixed a few small bugs

Added
Titant II is now awake and ready for battle!
This upgraded variant of the Slayer Boss is VERY powerful and hits hard! Make sure you are properly prepared before taking on such a formidable opponent!!!

notes.title: Update 0.3.0
notes.notes:
It's here, it's FINALLY here!!!
Update 0.3.0 is FINALLY finished and ready to go!!
I sincerely apologize for the insanely long wait for this update, life and motivation have both been really hard. But here it is and I sincerely hope the wait will have been worth it!!!

Story Changes
----------------------
* Nightshade Valley is now here! Prepare yourselves for the next part of Tim and friend's adventure!
* A new teammate has been spotted in Nightshade Valley! Be sure to find and save them!
* A new slayer boss has been sighted! Gear up and prepare for a nasty fight!
* Even more equipment, weapons, enemies and locations are now in the game!
* A new story event has been added to Chapter 1, aka Hazy Mines.

Bug Fixes and Changes
-----------------------------
* Fixed multiple spelling errors across the entire game.
* Fixed some layering issues with the buttons in the final puzzle of Hazy Mines.
* Made it more obvious when you get the key from the minecart in Hazy Mines.
* Changed some face expressions to match properly with the correct emotions.
* Changed around some of the Giant Bioluminescent Spider's ability chances.
* Fixed a bug where the doors in Hazy Mines don't take away your keys.
* Made Fire Gems slightly easier to obtain for the side quest in Minatia.
* Made the Wood Gathering into a proper quest that can be tracked to make it easier to remember what to do!
* Fixed the Wasp Wing side quest in Hazy Mines.
* Added even more interactables all around the world!
* Sliebomination II works properly now... sorry about that.
* Titant I description now shows the correct number of fights needed to fight the boss.
* Titant I now shows his model on the overworld instead of Sliebomination's model.
* Added some more enemy variants that can appear in the deeper parts of Hazy Mines.
* Added a new enemy to appear in the Sunken Temple.
* Updated the building textures in Trottaville and Minatia to be mroe detailed.
* Made the save animation a little shorter to let game flow smoother!
* Edited the way that Slayer Bosses work slightly to make enemy spawns and enemy loses work more consistently and change the way that they work. Now instead of getting a Game Over against enemies, it will send you back to the Slayer Hunter, just like it does against the Slayer Boss.
* Raised the initial level of Sophie and Gerrin.
*Nerfed Gerrin's Def stats.
* Buffed the Fluffy Bow.
* Fixed a bug with some juice in the Minatia blacksmith that would crash the game.
* Wave Caster now actually attacks! Wow!
* Slightly nerfed Titant I.
* Added battle backgrounds to the Sunken Temple.
* Added dialogue to both crafter npc's to tell you if you're missing gold or materials to craft.
* Nerfed the damage of all hornet enemies in World 1.
* Fixed a bug where the inn in Trottaville would cost more gold than it was suppose to after defeating King Slime.
* Buffed the King Gem.
* Fixed a handful of visual bugs.
* Buffed the amount of regen Slimy Bubble gives!
* Fixed locked doors to work on Action Button rather than Player Touch.
* Fixed a bug with door clipping.
* Fixed not being able to check the secret mural at the end of the Hazy Mines after the first interaction.
* Fixed some stairs taking you to the wrong location in World 1.
* Fixed some models showing stock RPG Maker Models rather than our custom models.
* Showed a bit more of how seriously the evil is effecting the world!
* FIxed a bug in Gooey Caverns where you spawn on top of the rocks when you have a Slayer Quest active.
* Gave Sophie a new spell with her World 1 gear.
* Lowered the basic material cost for all slayer equipment!
* Added animations to all buttons in Hazy Mines.
* Changed all save stations in the game into a purple gem to make them stand out more and easier to notice!
* GREATLY increased the chance for Gerrin's Slam attack to stun the enemy!

notes.title: Update/Apology
notes.notes:
Good morning everyone!
As we all know, the Summer Sales are here, and I haven't finished the new update yet.
I plan to have the update done this week, I just need to finish the last few bits of the new dungeon and than I'll be sending the game to my playtesters to check for bugs and glitches so that the update is much better than the last big update!
Due to missing some of the Steam Summer sales for the new update I plan to do a small giveaway sometime in the near future, though I'm still not sure of what, how, or when. But I'll be sure to keep everyone updated on when it happens!

Thank you all so much for the extreme patience. Next time you see a message here it will be the patch notes for Update 0.3.0!!! And I can't wait to show it off! It's HUGE!!!

See y'all than and much love!

notes.title: Patch 0.2.2
notes.notes:
Mark of the VOID
Patch 0.2.2

- -Multiple bug fixes with battle backgrounds, sprites being incorrect, and abilities not showing up correctly!
- -Nerfed multiple enemies and some bosses to make World 1 less frustrating (Hazy Mines)
- -Buffed a few held item abilities to be more worthwhile to use
- -Raised the starting level of both new teammates to better align with the level that most players are at when they reach the teammates
- -Made Bug Fangs and Bug Hides easier to obtain for the crafting in World 1
- -Nerfed Sliebomination I

I am also pleased to announce that work on Update 0.3.0 has now begun! Expect teasers and updates on the status of the new game chapter to be shared regularly!

I am also getting close to a point where I feel comfortable with announcing a new project that I have been working on for a while now! Be sure to stay tuned for that!!!
Thank you all and have a great day!!!

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1
notes.notes:
-Fixed a few map spots being able to walked on that weren't suppose to be able to be walked on.
-Added a new cutscene that plays after beating the Giant Bioilluminescent Spider.
-Added some missing lines of dialogue in multiple locations, as well as fixing some that were wrong.
-There is a new terror for you all to conquer. Sliebomination II has just been spotted and is ready to be challenged! Have you got what it takes?
-For both crafting NPC's they now also have an Upgrades tab that you can check out to upgrade the gear you can craft from them!

Apologies that this patch took so long. I took some time off for the holidays. That's why I decided to make this patch more of a mini update with a few new things to spice it up!

notes.title: 0.2.0 Release
notes.notes:
Version 0.2.0 is FINALLY here!!!
This is a large update!

-The new world, Hazy Caves, is now here and ready to be explored!
-The intro cutscene, as well as a few other story moments, have been completely reworked!
-Over 40 new enemies to defeat!
-A new teammate to be saved and added to your party!
-Some maps have been given a slight touch up
-Some balance changes to multiple enemies, weapons and armors, and a few bosses
-Some bug fixes
-An entirely ne..&)%^%(LLvlZZop@3 has been added!

This update has been extremely fun to work on and I sincerely hope you all enjoy what the new update has to offer!
See y'all in the next update patch!!!
